name: NIK Parse
description: Parse an Indonesian NIK locally. Returned NIK is masked.

function.name: nik_parse
function.description: Validate the NIK format, birth encoding and local region snapshot.

nik.description: NIK value, never included in logs.

name: NIK Validate
description: Perform concise local NIK structural validation.

function.name: nik_validate
function.description: Returns structural validation status, not official Dukcapil verification.

name: NIK Detect Crop
description: Detect a candidate NIK crop from an image through the multipart HTTP API.

function.name: nik_detect_crop
function.description: Use POST /api/nik/detect-crop with an image multipart file.

name: NIK Extract From Image
description: Extract visible document fields using an enabled Evonic vision model. No local OCR or image-processing dependency is used.

function.name: nik_extract_from_image
function.description: Read an authorized image and automatically use an enabled vision-capable Evonic model, or use the optional explicit vision_model_id.

path.description: Path to an authorized image attachment or artifact.

vision_model_id.description: Optional enabled, vision-capable Evonic model ID. Omit for automatic selection.

name: NIK Image Crop
description: Crop a geometric NIK, portrait, signature, or custom region from an authorized image.

function.name: nik_image_crop
function.description: Use the authorized image crop pipeline. Custom crops require coordinates and coordinate_space.
